metadata.title: Hawaiʻi AFN × hazard tract layer (CMIST)
metadata.privacy: Aggregate census-tract data only. No individual records.

method.power_dependent: HHS emPOWER county total allocated to tracts by share of county 65+ population (Medicare proxy). Estimate.
method.tsunami_share: share of 100 grid points inside the zone; exposed pop assumes even spread within the tract. tsunami_exposed_pop_est = standard evacuation zone; tsunami_extreme_exposed_pop_est = extreme zone (worst case)
method.nri_join: NRI v1.20 per-hazard layers joined on tract FIPS (2020 tracts); spatial fallback
method.afn_index: mean statewide percentile of C, M, I, S, T per-capita rates
